Menus, per person

Feed everyone, priced per head.

Our menus will give you an idea of what we serve. They are flexible and can be adjusted to your needs and dietary requirements. Just ask.

  • Hot menu 2

Boards, tables and platters

Cheese is the one item our customers consistently choose.

Each cheese board is put together by Ivona, the owner. Everything can be tailored to vegetarian, vegan, gluten free or dairy free needs.

£26per person

Grazing tables for 20 people and more: cheeses with crackers and chutneys, meats, antipasti, fresh and dried fruit, homemade sausage rolls, quiches and luxury canapés. The price includes setting up and decorating the table and disposable cutlery, plates and napkins. Travel costs apply. For fewer than 20, call to discuss.
